new_value: {"notes":"DECIDED: ChatContact.id and login are the MIMI user URI exactly as written; no base64url, no hashing (base JMAP Chat L217 'servers MUST treat it as opaque regardless of form', L425 id is String; same as the hub contact, mimi-00 L424). The agent takes senderId from the authenticated MLS sender's user, never from a peer-supplied field. Side issue to the draft (.12.1): RFC 8620 /get ids are Id[], and crate-jmap types ChatContact.id as Id (contact.rs:124), not String; it doesn't validate on deserialize, so URIs work today."}

{"notes":"DECIDED: ChatContact.id and login are the MIMI user URI exactly as written; no base64url, no hashing (base JMAP Chat L217 'servers MUST treat it as opaque regardless of form', L425 id is String; same as the hub contact, mimi-00 L424). The agent takes senderId from the authenticated MLS sender's user, never from a peer-supplied field. Side issue to the draft (.12.1): RFC 8620 /get ids are Id[], and crate-jmap types ChatContact.id as Id (contact.rs:124), not String; it doesn't validate on deserialize, so URIs work today.
REVISED by Mark 2026-10-18 (supersedes the URI-as-id text above): RFC 8620 §1.2 Ids are [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,255} and /get takes Id[], so ChatContact.id becomes a server-assigned Id and the MIMI user URI goes in login. Draft change (base draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 L217/L425 and mimi-00 L424) handed to crate-jmap-50. The agent assigns contact ids and puts the user URI in login; senderId still comes from the authenticated MLS sender's user.
2026-10-18: REOPENED. The ChatContact.id change was decided on an understated scope: base JMAP Chat L217 makes ChatContact.id the userId ('no separate identity namespace'), with about 34 dependent sites in the base draft and about 270 userId references across companion drafts (crate-jmap-50). Pending Mark's re-decision; don't assume the change has landed.
2026-10-18 RE-DECIDED by Mark (relayed by crate-jmap-50; jmap-chat-spec-ka7b): ChatContact.id is a server-assigned RFC 8620 Id, local to each server. The raw identity (MIMI user URI) goes in a new immutable, server-set property 'identity' (not login, not uri). Federation wire fields naming users carry identity strings; receivers map them to local ids. Agent: assigns contact ids and sets identity = the MIMI user URI; senderId still comes from the authenticated MLS sender's user. Plan against this; cite no spec text until the base-draft commit exists."}
